name: Wenzi Youxi
source: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!
translation: 文字游戏顾名思义就是文字游戏。玩家控制“我”寻找字里行间的线索，删除单词来改变句子的含义，或者移动单词来重写事实。“我”必须有足够的智慧和勇气来完成文字的使命。愿最好的“我”获胜！
